Corey Goode discusses his day-to-day life and duties as part of his 20 year commitment in a secret space program.

Former US Marine Mike Herrera discloses details about reverse-engineered SRF technology, which uses high-speed waves to influence physical and biological processes. This frequency can pass through solid objects without losing energy.

Herrera postulates that SRF has been used maliciously by impairing eyesight and worsening defective cells in targeted individuals. However, he believes that if disclosure were to happen, this technology could be used to help society evolve and heal. Herrera also suggests that it could dismantle status-based hierarchy, reducing control over society.

videos.title: Gigantic Greys & 6D Consciousness
videos.overview:
Why do Grey beings collaborate with humans, and what perspective of reality are they hoping to gain from us?

Tim, Tactical Advisor, recounts his profound experience of accessing six-dimensional consciousness, disintegrating from the earthly plane, and acting as an intermediary for a master line of gigantic Grey beings.

He explains that the Greys sought to collaborate with him to project their flawed perspective of reality, observing his responses and gaining deeper emotional insights. They hoped to integrate this information into their civilization, aiming to live beyond merely solving problems. This encounter underscores the larger purpose behind the Greys' interest in working with humans: to find their joy in life.

videos.title: New Insider Reveals Off-Planet Biosphere
videos.overview:
What plans are ETs making for humanity to live off-planet? Could a futuristic biosphere already be in the works, preparing for our arrival?

Victoria Whitney, a retired Navy defense officer and the official Omicron Commonwealth Chancellor recounts her initial encounter with an ET conclave and their vision for humanity’s future within the Omicron Commonwealth group. This organization is a collective of government officials working to bring a new era of unity and existence to our planet. She describes her remarkable journey with a secret assembly in the Pegasus constellation, where she explored an advanced biosphere designed for humans in the future.

According to Whitney, the ETs were resolute in their conviction that a new chapter for society must begin. Yet, this raises critical questions: What will become of Earth, and will the Draconians and serpent beings seize control of the 3rd density first?

videos.title: Andromedan Bioships & Liquid AI
videos.overview:
Why are Andromedans building bioships for other civilizations, and what impact does this have on the Galactic Federation?

Victoria Whitney, a retired Navy defense officer and the official Omicron Commonwealth Chancellor reveals her experiences with Andromedan shipbuilders. She describes their advanced wireframe technology for creating living bioships, where liquid AI infuses consciousness, integrates complex systems, and embeds emotions and personality. Whitney also highlights their ships' cutting-edge features, including jump gates for interstellar travel and self-healing abilities.

The Andromedans' bioships for the Galactic Federation are paramount in nurturing a collaborative spirit among interstellar races and driving galactic progress.

videos.title: Joining the Galactic Federation
videos.overview:
How are the Pleiadians and the Orions guiding humanity toward ascension and unity with the Galactic Federation?

Victoria Whitney, a retired Navy defense officer and the official Omicron Commonwealth Chancellor offers a compelling account of her encounters with the Pleiadians and the Orions from the ET conclave. She unveils their advanced abilities to download information, their deep knowledge of humanity's forgotten portals, and the significant role they play on Earth.

Whitney affirms that although they cannot fully intervene in our evolution, the ETs' intent is to help awaken humanity, guide us toward cosmic unity, and facilitate our integration into the Galactic Federation.

videos.title: Mission to the Dark Side of the Moon
videos.overview:
Why would ETs leave an advanced craft on Earth? Could it be an invitation to connect with an ancient civilization on the moon?

Retired counterintelligence agent Richard Doty reveals details of a UFO crash named Polyzena, which led to the highly classified operation, Sapphire Sele. The mission aimed to reverse-engineer the craft, build a replica, and establish a moon base. After multiple failed attempts, the military discovered they could only fly the ship telepathically.

On the dark side of the moon, they uncovered ancient structures, vast caves, and mysterious buildings. However, something disturbing occurred, halting further missions.

What did they encounter that left them so shaken?

videos.title: Operation Golden Deep & USOs
videos.overview:
What did an ET confrontation in the South Indian Ocean reveal about Unidentified Submersible Objects (USOs) and an aquatic-based civilization?

Retired counterintelligence agent Richard Doty discloses Navy encounters with USOs and an ET civilization believed to reside deep within the Indian Ocean. He sheds light on 1960’s Operation Golden Deep, where the US Navy tracked USOs emerging from Antarctica. Using advanced Deep Water Sonar Tracking (DWST), the Navy had an unbelievably close encounter with one of these crafts, leading to the discovery that an ET race had migrated from the stars and inhabited Earth's ocean floors for thousands of years.

Who are these mysterious beings, and what technologies enable them to thrive underwater?

videos.title: Miami Bayside Mall Incident
videos.overview:
What really happened at Miami Bayside Mall? Did a Naval Space Commander open a portal to remove three nine-foot-tall ETs?

Cornell Randy Cramer, a former member of the Earth Defense Force, discusses the legitimacy of ET landings and encounters in public spaces, such as the Miami Bayside Mall. He analyzes credible witness testimonies about nine-foot-tall nonhuman beings and the portals used for their transportation. Cramer also explores the possibility that the government uses holographic imaging to gauge public reactions to these encounters and how these experiences influence public perceptions.

videos.title: Subterranean ET Tech Rebooted
videos.overview:
Why is a vast underground computer network reactivating sacred sites around the globe? Could this signal that full disclosure is closer than realized?

Randy Cramer unveils an ancient, organic technological network hidden beneath the Earth's surface, functioning like an advanced computer. He explores their significance to ET civilizations and reveals how telepathic communication is facilitated off-planet. Cramer delves into why this system is being reactivated and upgraded to align with intergalactic standards.

videos.title: Arcturian Cloning Ceremonies
videos.overview:
What sacred practices do the Arcturians use to maintain their intergalactic status as one of the most advanced ET races?

Victoria Whitney, a retired Navy defense officer, reveals the ancient rituals and ceremonies of the Arcturians. She explains how they pass down sacred knowledge within their community through end-of-life rituals, preserve their pure lineage by maintaining original DNA patterns, and synchronize with their moon during collective cloning ceremonies. Paired with their profound understanding of energy, these practices are vital keys to their ongoing evolution and advancement.

videos.title: Dracos, Serpents & Our Galactic Victory
videos.overview:
As the Draconians and Serpent beings conspire, a great evil looms on the horizon. What path does humanity need to take in order to unite and prevail in this galactic war?

Victoria Whitney, a retired Navy defense officer, discusses antimatter weaponry, hyper tunneling, resource depletion, and the devastation of entire civilizations caused by the combined forces of the Dracos and Serpent beings. Despite Earth being in the line of fire, she expresses unwavering confidence in our ability to unify and triumph over these galactic adversaries by allying with the Galactic Federation.

videos.title: The Gate 3 Quataloid Incident
videos.overview:
How did a Quataloid ET manage to escape from S2 Anix North at Papoose Lake?

Richard Doty, a retired counterintelligence agent, discloses one of the most classified stories to emerge from Area 51: the escape of a Quataloid. After the U.S. government recovered an insect-like entity from a crash site in Nevada, it was contained in a hidden underground facility. Doty shares the gripping account of the being’s escape through a vault door, the chaos that ensued, and its eventual recapture.

While the Special Downed Aircraft Recovery Team (S-DART) gained valuable insights from this event, was their initial assessment of the being's threat truly accurate?

videos.title: 1953 Kingman UAP Crash
videos.overview:
Why was a UAP carrying uranium when it crashed in Kingman, Arizona?

Richard Doty, a retired counterintelligence agent, reveals details from the case file on the 1953 Kingman UAP crash. Doty recounts the sequence of events, including the survival of five ETs. He describes the interactions between these beings, the master sergeant, the deputy, and what the ship was carrying. When uranium was discovered, the Special Downed Aircraft Recovery Team (S-DART) raised critical questions: Was the uranium part of the UAP's propulsion system, or were they attempting to take it from us for another purpose?

videos.title: ET Contact: The Lt. Anderson Story
videos.overview:
Where did Lieutenant Gary Anderson go after his unexplained disappearance from a nuclear weapons storage facility?

Retired counterintelligence agent Richard Doty unveils the compelling story of the lieutenant and nuclear weapons technician who vanished for five years under highly classified circumstances. Doty delves into Anderson’s encounter with grey humanoid beings, their relentless pursuit of critical nuclear intelligence, and their use of advanced, mind-probing technology.

What was the hidden agenda behind Anderson's mysterious disappearance?

videos.title: The Double Life of a UFO Investigator
videos.overview:
What would motivate a pivotal UFO researcher to turn on his community and begin propagating government disinformation? And why does his story still haunt the UFO community?

Retired counterintelligence agent Richard Doty sheds light on William (Bill) Moore's path from renowned investigator to a central player in intelligence disinformation, including the infamous MJ-12 documents. He reveals Moore's complex legacy as both a respected UFO authority and a government asset, one who stirred confusion and cast a long shadow over the very field he helped shape.

videos.title: Galactic Invitation: The Les Ramey Story
videos.overview:
What happens when a former nuclear technician is invited to leave Earth and live among ETs?

Retired counterintelligence agent Richard Doty uncovers the extraordinary story of Les Ramey, whose quiet life in Nevada took a dramatic turn through a series of astonishing ET encounters. Ramey claims contact with robot-like beings, visits to other planets, telepathic communication, and the discovery of mysterious advanced technologies. Doty delves into the pivotal moment when Ramey was invited to live on another planet and the shadow government's efforts to keep his story hidden.

videos.title: New Jersey Drone Swarm & Mystery Orbs
videos.overview:
What is the mainstream media not telling you about the New Jersey drones? The White House claims mostly misidentifications, but New Jersey residents and authorities have another story to tell.

Retired counterintelligence agent Richard Doty leaks classified intelligence on the surge of drones, plasma orbs, and UAPs being reported over not just New Jersey, but also worldwide. Doty shares insights from highly secretive briefings with the Advanced Working Group, a coalition of former intelligence agents, scientists, and military executives.

With all of these dramatic events unfolding in real-time, could we be crossing a threshold that pushes us to full disclosure?

videos.title: New Whistleblower Exposes Reptilian Stargate
videos.overview:
A new whistleblower risks everything to expose a highly classified stargate protected by reptilians in the Middle East.

Sébastien Martin steps out of the shadows as a CIA remote viewer to reveal a lost stargate, allegedly taken from Saddam Hussein’s Summer Palace. He recounts a chilling psychic attack by a reptilian during his missions and exposes the Kruger Organization — a covert group tied to the deaths of scientists decoding ET technology and a hidden force controlling humanity’s most powerful institutions.

Once an ordinary man, Martin’s life changed when he began experiencing vivid, real-time visions of global events, from natural disasters to high-profile assassinations. His extraordinary abilities as a highly advanced remote viewer soon caught the attention of intelligence agencies, granting him access to some of the largest cover-ups in history.

videos.title: Anunnaki Alaskan Pyramid
videos.overview:
Could it be possible that a massive underground pyramid in Alaska is harnessing plasma energy to regenerate USAP motherships — and if so, who is hijacking its power?

Perception-based intelligence specialist Sébastien Martin uncovers shocking details about this mysterious structure, its Annunaki origins, and its role as a powerful energy conductor for USAP (Unacknowledged Special Access Programs). He investigates how this hidden pyramid may be linked to unexplained disappearances, disrupt aircraft navigation, and even alter human perception — raising urgent questions about who built it and why it remains active.

videos.title: Pleiadian Ultra-Tech Cities
videos.overview:
How are Pleiadian AI-driven cities creating environments with perfect energetic equilibrium? What do they model for humanity's technological future?

Victoria Whitney, Chancellor of the Omicron Commonwealth, unveils the inner workings of AI-driven cities — self-sustaining, regenerative societies based on 42 universal laws and engineered to enhance wellbeing, maintain balance, and eliminate waste. She explores how these futuristic environments can harness luminescent water, harmonic frequencies, and photon energy transfer.

Can humanity claim these extraordinary advancements and make the quantum leap to become free cosmic citizens?

videos.title: Orion Empire: The Cosmic Black Market
videos.overview:
Is the Orion Empire running the largest interstellar black market — and why is Earth being locked out of the deal?

Victoria Whitney, Chancellor of the Omicron Commonwealth exposes the Orion Empire and their vast, unregulated trade hubs. She shares about the species exchange of weapons, human DNA, advanced ET technology, and the highly sophisticated jump gate systems used to traverse the cosmos.

With four major trade centers spanning multiple star systems, their influence is undeniable. But what else is being exchanged in these covert markets and does humanity even want to be involved?

videos.title: The Arcturian Starseed Project
videos.overview:
For eons, a mysterious celestial experiment has sculpted life on Earth.

Victoria Whitney, Chancellor of the Omicron Commonwealth, delves into the mysteries of Delthinae Erial — a futuristic Arcturian crystal city where the three founder races seeded humanity. She uncovers the hidden role of the Arcturians as custodians of starseed heritage on our planet, guarding an age-old living archive that contains the essential blueprints of our cosmic lineage and the keys to our unfolding fate.

videos.title: Captive ETs at Sandia Labs
videos.overview:
The Secret Space Programs (SSP) are willing to extract information by any means necessary, but is there a limit?

Sébastien Martin, a perception-based intelligence specialist (remote viewer), exposes the secretive depths of Sandia Labs, revealing the dire conditions of humanoid beings incarcerated within glass enclosures. Surrounded by gas chambers and deprived of their telepathic abilities, these beings endure a distressing environment, manipulated and observed as mere subjects for analysis.

As Martin unveils the harsh realities faced by humanoid ETs, one must question: In the SSP’s relentless pursuit of technological advancement, has all morality been sacrificed?

videos.title: Hybrid Files: SSP’s DNA Experiments
videos.overview:
New evidence suggests the Grey hybridization program is a human-engineered facade. If so, what nefarious organizations could be behind it… and why?

Sébastien Martin, a perception-based intelligence specialist, delves into the shadowy world of hybrid programs orchestrated by the Secret Space Programs (SSP) and other dark establishments like the Krueger Group.

While others think the hybridization program is a slow infiltration of ETs on our planet, Martin suggests a new perspective. He reveals how these hybrids are bred and enhanced for specific missions ranging from cloaked combat operations against the Dracos to subtle communication roles on Earth.

Martin also hints at his own potential hybrid origins, sharing a personal anecdote that raises questions about his unique life and biological circumstances.

videos.title: ET Hybrid Capture at Radiant Springs
videos.overview:
What happens when ET-human hybrids walk among us, and how far would the government go to contain the threat of disclosure?

Retired counterintelligence agent Richard Doty reveals details of Operation Radiant Springs, a covert mission to capture a hybrid. This hybrid enabled the aggressive Quataloid ET species to infiltrate Bolling Air Force Base and harm high-ranking military personnel. Doty recounts the high-stakes pursuit by multiple agencies that led to the hybrid's capture and emphasizes the complicated nature of hybrids on Earth.

videos.title: Echo 3 Incident & EBEN Aftermath
videos.overview:
Did a UFO crash spark a secret alliance with extraterrestrials? Are these ETs still quietly embedded within classified government programs?

In 1976, something extraordinary shattered the silence at a remote Intercontinental Ballistic Missile (ICBM) site — an unidentified craft collided with Minuteman missile silos, setting off a covert chain of events.

Retired counterintelligence agent Richard Doty pulls back the curtain on the infamous Echo Three incident, where beings were recovered from the wreckage. These ETs, now known as Extraterrestrial Biological Entities (EBENs), didn’t just survive; they collaborated.

What began as a crash site may have become a handshake across the stars.

videos.title: The Baltimore ET Confrontation
videos.overview:
Harvard psychiatrist Dr. John Mack wasn’t just researching ET experiences...he was feeding intelligence to the U.S. government.

When Mack met “Maggie,” a quiet schoolteacher with a disturbing story, it set off a covert surveillance operation and an encounter no one could explain. She spoke of being taken from her home to a strange facility. But under hypnosis, something deeper emerged — this wasn’t her first time. The visitations had started long ago.

Retired counterintelligence agent Richard Doty pulls back the curtain on the real story: the government stakeout, the surveillance footage… and the moment agents confronted off-world humanoids inside her bedroom.

videos.title: Bioengineered Andromedan Pilots
videos.overview:
What if the galaxy’s most advanced pilots weren’t born but engineered?

Victoria Whitney, chancellor of the Omicron Commonwealth, unveils the world of Andromedan lineage-pure beings. Bioengineered in pairs for specific missions, these beings are embedded from inception with AI-enhanced skill sets and spiritual programming. They don’t just fly their ships — they merge with them, navigating through holographic thought, empathy, and energetic precision.

Whitney explores the ethics of intentional creation, the fusion of technology and soul, and a society that only births what it needs. From moon-sized space stations to vessels that self-heal like living organisms, the Andromedans may be modeling the next phase of biological technology.
